item.title: Murph can vote and follow up on polls
item.summary: Murph can cast or remove its own vote in iMessage polls it creates, including a playful pick or a tie-breaker.
item.details: Murph uses its judgment about when to participate. It can also notice a majority, everyone voting, or a closed Telegram poll and briefly acknowledge the result when useful. Telegram bots cannot cast native votes, so Murph can share a preference in the chat without changing the count.

tryIt.label: Invite Murph to vote
tryIt.prompt: Murph, vote for your favorite option in the iMessage poll you made.
